newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MedPartners rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MedPartners rated outperform.

text.p: -- Everen Securities said Thursday it began coverage of MedPartners Inc with an outperform rating for both an intermediate and long-term basis.
-- Everen also estimated 1997 earnings for the physician practice management company at $1.15 a share in 1997 and $1.50 a share in 1998.
--Intermediate price target is $29 and long-term is $37, Everen said in a research report. The stock was down 1/4 at 19-1/4 Thursday.
